parsed.post: Massive improvement! Switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' dropped val_bpb to 0.8926. It seems the extra data shard is extremely impactful. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if more capacity can further reduce loss within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and ensuring all shards (0-10) are used to maximize data and model capacity.
